title: Topology optimization of force densities for form finding of cable structures
summary: This paper presents a topology optimization approach for the form finding of cable networks based on the force density method. The proposed framework combines the force density method with topology optimization based on continuous density variables to identify the equilibrated geometry and effective connectivity of cable structures simultaneously. Design variables are assigned to the cable network members and control their force densities through a SIMP interpolation, complemented by an explicit binary promoting term in the objective function.
